summary: Trimble Inc. filed an 8-K on October 2, 2026 disclosing entry into a $500 million unsecured delayed-draw term loan credit agreement with Bank of America as administrative agent. No loans were drawn at signing; up to four draws are permitted on or before January 29, 2027, with undrawn commitments terminating automatically. Loans mature two years after initial borrowing. Interest is alternate base rate or term SOFR plus rating/leverage-based margins, with a ticking fee of 0.075%-0.275% on undrawn amounts from December 1, 2026. This is a routine financing, not a special situation.
